display_name: LoRa W24 实收增益联合训练
description: 匹配训练检验实收噪声驱动的中心修正强度，固定 Full 七景。
authorization: Active LoRa DURA W24 performance goal and user instruction to launch when memory permits.

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI pinned W24 archives for fit/inference; Windows phase1-cu128 for independent scoring.
code.cwd: Original 7615e8e4 archived training release for fitting; archived W24 inference release for prediction.

data.representation: At fit 8192 complex points; at W24 readout 8 chirps × I/Q × (384 center + 48 native edge).
data.physical_ids_ref: Ordered source V physical IDs and archived blind RX order, 2000 target packets per receiver
data.label_map_ref: Original W24 frozen class mapping; target labels scorer only
data.leo_config_ref: Registered native Full practical views only.

permissions.claim_scope: TX-blind source U IQ and paired generic perturbations only until freeze. Source V and, if qualified, Full-only target; no Residual execution.

checkpoint.initialization: Both arms scratch, identical two-prior network and initial state.

sources.role: Archived code and frozen external comparator only

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Native W24 matched source fit proof, exact reader F/complete.json binding, fixed blind control archive
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: No weights inherited during fitting. Runtime source metadata and frozen state require original contract. No target or TX ancestry in fit.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Freeze both at step 3600. On identical 300 Full source V packets, adaptive effective half must beat direct, matched fixed readout, and original 40k all-half on the six-scene count, meet all three on low urban, and meet direct on clean. Only then dispatch three Full formal shards of 10,000 packets each.

execution.gpu_policy: Physical GPU pool 0, 3, 7 in enumerated order, one worker per GPU for this run, two total, at least 12 GiB free, fewer than eight compute processes per card; preserve other owners.
execution.stop_rule: Stop dependent phases on wrong role, invalid gradients/numerics, source baseline mismatch, missing artifacts or formal prediction mismatch. Preserve artifacts and other jobs.

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: Independent source score; formal local experiments.pamf_lora_main.w24_third_prior collect-score --readout after frozen shards.

rows.seed_notes: Seed 2026112991 fixes source row ordering and generic perturbations. Source V panel 2026112559. Test waveform stream inherits 2026112207; evaluation identifies W24 E104 model seed. Phase1 has no support or K.
rows.optimizer: AdamW, cosine 2e-4 to 2e-5, weight decay 1e-4, clip 1.
rows.budget_ref: 3600 optimizer updates at batch 16; identical schedule.

notes: Both arms use identical 20,000 U_s fit packets, 500 held U_s, random initialization, generic perturbation stream and AdamW schedule at 3,600 batch-16 updates. They retain two learned priors and four CG steps.

Only the effective final endpoint varies. With native, receive-only off-band noise variance q aggregated by chirp power, define g = 0.5 + q/(q + 0.275^2). The adaptive endpoint is y + 2*g*(z-y) and actual deployed writeback uses half that endpoint edit. The auxiliary full-final and full diagnostic also use the scaled endpoint. The fixed arm uses z and delivers half of its unscaled edit.

Pre-solve coarse output, first MAP, native edges, F parameters, head, preprocessing, class map and inference rules remain fixed by the original recipe and archived bindings. Raw clean pairs are used only for source IQ training loss. No simulator trace, source TX, W24 weights/outputs, V or target during fit.
The user requested Full only. Formal targets are 162000/180000 practical, 25500/30000 low urban, 28566/30000 clean.
